title: Source inventory (pluggable source-ingestion output)
description: The common source-inventory envelope emitted by scripts/ingest_sources.py — the pluggable source-ingestion module (issue #13). A `source` is one system of record (a database, an API, a product catalog, a schema file); it holds `entities` (tables/resources/types), each holding `fields` (columns/properties/attributes). Every level carries optional status/owner/provenance so the inventory captures not just shape but standing (where it came from, who owns it, how far along the audit is). READ-ONLY: generated by the registered extractor adapters; author the inputs, recompile. Feeds the gen-brain.py `source_inventory` adapter (Source/Entity/Field nodes + has_entity/has_field/sourced_by edges).

x-conflict.readonly_reason: compiled artifact — author the source inputs, recompile via make sources

provenance.description: Where a node was extracted from: the extractor adapter that produced it and the input path/locator it read.

kind.description: Source category — e.g. database, api, catalog, schema, csv.
